描述_EN: they are the dragon of the east, the bird of the south (whose head emerges in openwork above the edge of the ring), the tiger of the west, and the tortoise of the north. it would have been used in a daoist ritual. the pattern on both sides of this jade ring shows the animals of the four quarters.
描述_ZN: 它们是东方的龙、南方的鸟（其头部在戒指边缘上方出现镂空）、西方的虎和北方的龟。 它应该是用于道教仪式的。 这枚玉环两边的图案显示了四方的动物。
